fixes: da91fe3a fix(quic): start initial flight at accepted packet number
d3f4ee73 fix(quic): acknowledge first handshake CRYPTO packet
purpose: Re-run external client-role interop gates after the two client handshake fixes.

environment.note: An initial quic-go invocation without GO_BIN failed with exit 127 because go was not on PATH; every recorded gate below uses the pinned GO_BIN.

gates.result: Both roles passed certificate verification, hq-interop ALPN, DATAGRAM, deterministic loss and reorder on netz outbound, surviving stream sibling 4 and exact peer close.
Both roles passed 32-stream mixed churn with 16 FIN and 16 reset terminals, exact bytes/checksum/reset mask, and deterministic loss and reorder on netz outbound.
Both roles passed, including migration, migration-loss and NAT-rebinding cases.
Both roles passed QUIC v1/v2 with H3_REQUEST_CANCELLED, dropped STOP_SENDING, concurrent sibling, connection reuse, 8-KiB stream window, 128-KiB response and request/response trailers.
Both roles passed RFC 9220 Extended CONNECT, Origin, subprotocol, masked fragmented text, permessage-deflate without context takeover, ping/pong, close 1000 and reciprocal KeyUpdate.
Both roles passed GET, byte Range, POST, ORIGIN, connection reuse and two-phase GOAWAY(4) drain with Retry disabled and forced.
Both roles passed CONNECT admission headers, DATAGRAM with oversized rejection, bidi/uni streams, reset/stop, concurrent sibling, reuse, drain before connection close and peer close.
